mostWorthwhile.text: Salvaging the shipping frame for the array's feet was the most worthwhile passage: it connected the loose-ground problem to a practical reuse of available material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power lead felt predictable because it was the only offered action, though it provided a satisfying resolution.

surprise.text: I hadn't anticipated that the transport brackets would sink into loose ground or that the shipping frame could provide broader feet.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the explanations connected the available combinations to freeing and powering the array.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical construction was satisfying, and I'm curious how the expedition and the promised ascent fuel will develop.
